1209.Description: Max HP +<style="accent-gn">3%</style>, Mastery +<style="accent-gn">2%</style>, up to <style="accent-gn">3</style> stacks.

1210.Description:
Every 2 STR/INT/AGI converts to 1 ATK.
Every 1 Endurance converts to 8 Max HP.
Every 1% Haste converts to 0.6% Attack SPD and 1% Casting SPD.
Every 1% Versatility increases outgoing DMG, healing, and shields by 0.35% and DMG Reduction by 0.15%.
Every 1% Mastery converts to a 0.5% universal damage bonus.

1211.Description: <style="accent-gn">Expertise Skill</style> Attack SPD +<style="accent-gn">5%</style> for <style="accent-gn">10</style>s, stacking up to <style="accent-gn">5</style> times.

1213.Description: Deals <style="accent-gn">35% × stack count</style> ATK as <style="physical">Attack DMG</style> every <style="accent-gn">2</style>s for <style="accent-gn">10</style>s, stacking up to <style="accent-gn">10</style> times. When <style="accent-gn">Burn</style> reaches max stacks, any newly applied <style="accent-gn">Burn</style> immediately deals <style="accent-gn">35%</style> ATK as <style="physical">Attack DMG</style>.

1214.Description: Deals <style="accent-gn">800%</style> ATK as <style="physical">Attack DMG</style> to enemies in range, and grants <style="accent-gn">10</style> <style="accent-gn">Flame Soul</style>.

1215.Description: Deals <style="accent-gn">500%</style> ATK as <style="physical">Attack DMG</style> to enemy targets.

1216.Description:
Each hit has a chance to add extra stages based on the current skill multiplier:
Formless Flame Slash Stage 1 Chance: 20%.
Formless Flame Slash Stage 2 Chance: 10%.
Formless Flame Slash Stage 3 Chance: 5%.

1217.Description: Deals <style="physical">Attack DMG</style> equal to <style="accent-gn">800%</style> of ATK to enemies within range.

1218.Description:
When taking DMG, if own HP percentage is higher than the attacker's, DMG taken from that attacker is reduced by 10%.
When dealing DMG, if own HP percentage is higher than the target's, DMG dealt to that target is increased by 5%.

1219.Description:
Every 2 STR/INT/AGI converts to 1 ATK.
Every 1 Endurance converts to 8 Max HP.
Crit %, Luck %, Mastery %, Haste %, and Versatility % lose their original effects and gain a new ability: The skill damage of the current Resonance Skill is guaranteed to Crit, but the Crit DMG is fixed and calculated as the sum of Crit % + Luck % + Mastery % + Haste % + Versatility %.
